bio.text: Jacob Burnett is an independent write-in candidate for governor of Idaho in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to the Idaho Capital Sun.
In the Idaho Capital Sun voter guide, he lists his hometown as Middleton, his occupation as self-employed, and says he has lived in Idaho for 30 years.
